notes.title: Drunk Builder Simulator: New Game Mode
notes.notes:
New more dynamic and faster game mode with the foreman
In the new game mode on new map, builders have time to finish the job, and when they sober up, they respawn after some time
In this mode, the foreman is faster and deals more damage, the goal of the foreman is to not let anyone work drunk. 

- Added tutorial level which explains how to play in this game

notes.title: Drunk Builder Simulator: New Game Mode
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed hammer and the issue that objects was not hitten
- Improved Chief Camera
- Minor fixes
- Reworked a little base map
- Fixed foreman camera goes under map

[h1]NEW GAME MODE: KING OF DESTRUCTION[/h1]

New game mode now is avaible 
In the new mode, without a foreman, drunk construction workers competing with each other, who destroys the more objects and become King of Destruction
objects to destroy are randomly selected. In this mode you still have to drink alcohol, but the poop automatically renews after a time.

notes.title: Drunk Builder Simulator: Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Drunk builder Simulator Update[/b][/h1]


[b]Improvements:[/b]
- fixed Dropping player under map
- Improved collisions of throwed poop
- Now chief are not ragdolling when fall
- Now ragdoll will not be activated when player jump on trampoline/net
- Now sprint dont take more percents/s
- Player is getting faster up after ragdoll
- Added ambience music
- minor fixes

[b]Balance:[/b]
- Lowered alcohol percentages loss
- Lowered foremans damage
- Now one bottle of alcohol can last for longer
- Lowered stuff builders has to do to win match
- Mounting planks is now faster

[b]New stuff:[/b]

1. New tool HAMMER
Now to find alcohol instead of interaction u have to hit box with Hammer
Hammer tool is avaible when player press on keyboard 3.
boxes are still respawning

[previewyoutube=Vi9TzZs2uqw;full][/previewyoutube]

2. New hittable object 
There are now propane tanks on the maps hit them with hammer to make a big explosion

[previewyoutube=lXrxdPd5R28;full][/previewyoutube]

3. New task for builders
Driving a rod into the ground
Added new task for builders, rods in the ground which requires to be hitting with hammer 3 times to complete

[previewyoutube=qegYwv5YDEU;full][/previewyoutube]
